tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba lam gyi rim pa bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rgya gar skad du/ dā sha ga thā nā ma mārga kra ma/ bod skad du/ tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba lam gyi rim pa/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog tu bla ma la ni dang por phyag 'tshal ye shes btsun mo rdo rje bde mar gus btud nas/ /rigs can legs par grags pa mgu ba skyed byed sngags rgyud lam ni spyan ldan kun gyis bshad pa dang*/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje'i lung ni thos par gyur pas nges par bya'o bdun gyi nges pa 'di/ /lam dang bcas pa'i zla ba rta dmar sa yi tshul ni lag pa'i rim pa de rjes spyod dang 'bras/ /rtog pa'i rnal 'byor dang ni dran pa gcig dang gsal bar dmigs pa dang bcas rdzogs pa 'di rnams la/ /rnam gsum tshogs kyi lam du 'gyur te ye shes gsum dang rnam par rtog pa gsum bral ye shes sku/ /phra mo gsum nyams de bzhin byang chub skad cig gsum ni bcu gnyis sbyor ba'i lam stai don dam gyi/ /dga' ba'i bden pa mngon rtogs mthong ba'i lam ste bcu gnyis sa ni yan lag bdun no de las 'bras/ /dro ba nas ni chos kyi mchog dang thog ma de bzhin tha ma'i sa mthar ri bong can 'gag go /gcig ni rtog dang gnyis pa sbyor ba de dag bden pa mthong bas 'gag cing 'gags pa de las slar/ /sa bcu'i tha mar dbugs dag 'gog pa rags dang dbus ma dang ni phra mo'i dbye ba shes par bya/ /byis pa'i lam dang chos kyi sku ni bcu dang bcas pa 'dir ni sa ste rtsa la sogs rnams kyi/ /bgrod pa 'gyel ba'i sbyor ba bcu gnyis sa ru 'gyur te 'od gsal de bzhin mtshungs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'pho ba dang bcas khu ba 'gags pas lus dang ngag yid rdo rje'i rgyu nyid do/ /'phags pa rnams kyi bcu gnyis sa la de rnams nyid kyi phra mo sa bon dang bcas shin tu 'gags/ /sna tshogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan cing chos kyi sprin las shin tu dbye ba tha ma'i sa gsum po/

/tha dad gzhung lugs sna tshogs rgyud du bstan pa dag ni cung zad cung zad dbye ba kho na ste/ /bar chad med dang rnam par grol bar dus kyi 'khor lo las byung gzhan du sbyor dang bcas pa yang*/ khyad par lam yang kha cig tu ste stong pa gsum dang sku yi rab dbye rgyud dang rgyud du ste/ / kun tu 'od sogs slob dang mi slob sa rnams re rer bcu gnyis bcu gnyis kun la dbye bas so/ /rim pa dang po tshogs kyi sa dang skye ba gcig gis thogs par 'gyur la dro ba chen por ni/ /kun kyang bgrod pa gcig tu zhugs shing snang ba la sogs thob la bar dor 'da' dang skye ba'ang yod/ /bdag la byin rlabs thob nas skye bar mi 'gyur gang phyir gnas skabs gsum la 'phags pa'-i gnas thob po/ /grub pa'i khyad par 'ga' dang bcom ldan min yang rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pas lus gzhan nges par sgyur/ /'bras bu dang mtshungs rtog pa'-i rgyu can bde ba che dang stong pa'i rnam pa lha yi gzugs brnyan ni/ /bde ba cung zad lam du byed nus snang dang 'dzin pa lhod byed rdzogs pa sbyong ba dang po ste/ / ma rtags lus dang sems las ye shes 'byung ba dbu mar byed pa sna tshogs bcing ba nyid las so/ /skyed pas drangs dang nang gi bde rig mngon sum lha dag lhan cig skyes pa rgyu dang bcas par dbye/ /grub pa spyod pa'i rgyu can dang po tshe dang sku yi don dang de nyid rnam par sbyong ba dang*/ /sems can don dang don chen nye ba'i rgyu ni gzhan yang nye tshe lam la sna tshogs dbye ba ste/ /ngo bo nyid dang de bzhin gzhan ni spyod pa'i tshul dang dgos pa dag stai slar yang de nas gzhan/ /gnas kyi dbye ba mdzad de dus dang cho ga na tshod bsam pa 'dod chags shes rab kyis kyang gzhan/ /drag shul sbyor ba rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te rim pa gnyis la stong nyid goms pa dag gis so/ /gcig ni 'jig rten dngos grub don no glang po'i bdag po rta yis 'thab bzhin rdzogs pa la gnas pas/

/ mtshan ma'i spyod la 'jug pa nyid do dbang skur ba dang yongs su 'brel ba'i nye ba'i rgyu zhes bya/ /sems dben pa dang nges par byang chub gnyis kyang dbang las gyur pa sprul dang longs spyod rdzogs las so/ /bzhi dang bcu drug sku ste ye shes rnam pa lnga ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pa 'bras bu ste/ /sku dang brjod tshul zhing dang mdzad pa 'di la rang dang gzhan rgyud bden pa gnyis kyi dbye bas so/ /de ltar bdag gis bla ma chen po'i gzhung ni tshigs bcad brgya phrag gnyis las snying po tsam zhig bsdus/ /lam ni lnga pa bstan pa'i don 'dir 'bad pa'i dge las 'gro ba kun la ye shes rgyas gyur cig /ces tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba lam gyi rim pa'o/ /slob dpon bud+dha gup+tas nye bar sbyar ba'o/ /bla ma de nyid la legs par brten cing nyan nas/ slar yang de nyid kyi slob ma pur+ṇ+ṇa badz+ra la zhus te/ tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ// //dus rnams kun tu nad med tshe ring zhing*/ /sdig dang 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi nas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs kun/ /'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas so/ /par yig gnyis kyi 'du byed byams rgyan dge / shubhaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba lam gyi rim pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 72 -- PAGE 73 -- PAGE 70 -
